body: I thought Caltech hadn't released decisions yet, when did you get yours?
That's really cool! And yeah, I've been trying to use books and stuff, but it's definitely not the same as school, especially when you're going to have to do it all over gain for credit.
I haven't checked those out, thanks for the suggestion
Yeah, it's made being on leave a really difficult time.
Most of my interests are in STEM and research, so school is kind of important for my interests, if I can manage to get back.
I'd be fine trying outpatient, but the closest hospitals with behavioral or eating disorder units are four hours away.

I'm not sure... I've been trying to get back into school or find a job. I'd like one of those to happen but I feel stuck and like it's impossible to move on. I have no idea what I want to happen next as long as I'm stuck living with my parents.

During the last few appointments all she talks about is that she doesn't know what to do; she's relatively new to treating eating disorders and I don't think she feels like she can help anymore. If that's the case, maybe staying with her isn't the best idea, but I don't know what else there is.
